name: Pagination
summary: Links to move through pages of results: numbered with gaps, previous and next only, or a load more row.
description: Use numbered pagination when people may jump to a page, the simple form for reading in order, and load more for feeds. In narrow slots the numbered form keeps only the arrows on Previous and Next.

classes.name: v-pagination
classes.description: The list of pages, on a <ul> inside <nav>. A size container, so it adapts to its slot.

classes.name: v-page
classes.description: One page link, or a <span> for an end that is not available.

classes.name: v-page-prev
classes.description: Previous page, with a drawn arrow that flips in right-to-left text.

classes.name: v-page-next
classes.description: Next page, with a drawn arrow that flips in right-to-left text.

classes.name: v-page-label
classes.description: The Previous or Next text. Visually hidden in narrow slots, still read by screen readers.

classes.name: v-page-gap
classes.description: The ellipsis between page ranges. Mark it aria-hidden.

classes.name: v-pagination-simple
classes.description: Previous and next at the ends with a page count between.

classes.name: v-pagination-info
classes.description: The page count text, such as Page 2 of 9.

classes.name: v-load-more
classes.description: A centred row with a count and a Load more button.

states.description: On the current page: accent border and tint.
On a <span class="v-page"> for an end that is not available, such as Previous on page 1: dimmed.

a11y: Wrap the list in a <nav> with an aria-label, such as Results pages.
Give number links an aria-label like Page 4, and mark the current one with aria-current="page".
An unavailable Previous or Next is a <span>, not a link, so it is not in the focus order.
After Load more, move focus to the first new item or announce how many were added.
